description: Tax withheld on a supplemental payment (bonus, commission, RSU vest, stock option exercise or lump sum) paid on top of a regular salary, using the country's official withholding method (for example the IRS supplemental flat rate, HMRC cumulative PAYE, the CRA bonus method), line by line, next to the final tax the payment adds at the person's real rates, so over- or under-withholding shows. Countries: sg, fr, nl, es, de, us, uk, au, nz, ca, ie, in. Types are limited for au (bonus, commission, lump_sum), ie (bonus, commission, rsu_vest, lump_sum); other countries take every type. region is REQUIRED for: us, ca; optional for: es, de, uk; a missing or unknown region returns the valid codes. Other countries return the list of supported ones. Returns the tax year, the method, official source URLs and the calcbloc.com page. Not yet supported: cross-border salary withholding (multi-country payroll), and the double-tax relief amount (get_tax_treaties lists the treaty withholding limits CalcBloc stores).

amount.description: The supplemental payment (gross), in the country's currency.

country.description: Country short code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in lower case; the UK is "uk", "gb" also works), e.g. "us", "uk", "ca", "de", "in", "au", "nz", or the English name. Older keys such as "new-zealand" also work. See list_countries.

gross_salary.description: Regular gross salary for the year, before the supplemental payment, in the country's currency (annual in every country).

options.description: Country-specific options. Examples: US {"filing_status":"mfj","method":"aggregate","ytd_supplemental":900000} (filing_status: single | mfj | hoh; method: flat | aggregate), UK {"tax_code_number":1257,"month_paid":12}, Germany {"tax_class":3,"church":true}. Call list_countries with the country to see every option, its allowed values and its default.

region.description: Region code or name. Required for: us, ca; optional for: es, de, uk. Examples: US "ca" or "California", Canada "on", UK "scotland". list_countries with the country lists every code.

type.description: Kind of payment. Default: bonus. Types are limited for au (bonus, commission, lump_sum), ie (bonus, commission, rsu_vest, lump_sum); other countries take every type.

name: calculate_supplemental_withholding

attribution.description: Always "Data by CalcBloc"; show it with the figures.

calcblocUrl.description: The calcbloc.com page for this result.

difference.description: totalLiability − totalWithheld: positive = more due at filing, negative = refund; null when unknown.

grossSalary.description: Regular gross salary for the year, before the payment.

liability.description: Extra final tax the payment adds at the person's real rates (null where it cannot be computed from official data).

retrievedAt.description: Date CalcBloc last checked the source.

withheld.description: Withheld from the payment by the employer.

sources.description: Official sources for the rates used.

retrievedAt.description: Date CalcBloc last checked the source.

type.description: Payment type: bonus, commission, rsu_vest, option_exercise or lump_sum.

title: Calculate withholding on a bonus or other supplemental pay
